title: One Hive pin (v1)
description: Canonical representation of an immutable reference to a file or directory at an exact git commit. Strict consumers MUST reject unknown fields.

repository.description: Stable repository id resolved through the repository registry.

commit_oid.description: Algorithm-prefixed full commit OID. Never abbreviated, never a ref.

path.description: NFC, repository-relative POSIX path; no leading '/', no '.'/'..'/empty component, no NUL/CR/LF/backslash. The single '.' means the whole repository tree.

object_oid.description: Algorithm-prefixed full blob or tree OID at commit_oid:path.

content_digest.description: Independent SHA-256 over the raw file bytes (file) or the canonical tree manifest (tree).
